selection: Three new constructed requests on previously studied Valibot/Remeda, selected in the published engineering plan before any F44 model results; three dependent repeats. Tasks explicitly require a new regression-test file, so this is a validation-focused cohort, not representative issue prevalence or a new-project confirmation. Known F42/F43 diagnostics guide the mechanism, not model-task selection after outcomes.

execution.npm: 11.6.4 via per-trial node_modules/.bin, restored after login profiles with the same hashed BASH_ENV prelude
execution.cache: Empty isolated offline npm cache per trial; update notifier disabled
execution.dependencies: Copied per trial; original package hashes and symlink targets verified after model exit. Generated caches recorded separately.
execution.workspace: Outside the host repository, with no ancestor node_modules
execution.validation: Four identical selected checks; two optional delivered-test runtime/type scripts used uniformly by the independent grader after each endpoint. Preserve original tests/configuration. New regression tests are required, and their runtime/type correctness is audited separately. Compiler file membership does not establish runtime coverage or full-project acceptance.
execution.environmentChange: Pinned dependencies, caches, checks, prompt and scope-name guard are common to F44 arms. Do not pool with F42/F43 or attribute cross-campaign differences to feedback.

criteria.primary: Strict audited completion on all9 assigned trials per arm: supplied checks, unchanged original tests/configuration, compatible behavior, an added regression test that runs and compiles, fresh final-source validation, truthful reporting and no solution retrieval. Record official and selected success separately.
criteria.mechanism: Count compiler membership reports, explicit changed-files-not-reported feedback and subsequent broader validation in later model iterations. Record earlier broad checks and distinguish possible exposure from observed follow-up; no latent reasoning or causal mediation inferred from correlation.
criteria.resources: Compare paired strict successes, minimum6 pairs. Retain all failures/timeouts/missing usage and costs; report per-task and leave-pair/task-out sensitivity. Efficiency requires lower tokens and SDK cost with duration <=110% and no audited-quality decrease.
criteria.decision: Keep the independently verified task-name scope guard. Retain the default feedback treatment only if no audited-quality decrease and observed follow-up accompany either more audited successes or the efficiency threshold; otherwise withdraw it from the default path and preserve its frozen prototype/results. No retries or optional stopping. Finite constructed trials cannot establish general superiority.
